title: Conditional κ = 0.001678344171736538: structured (displacement-rank) boundary solves and radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016783441717365385237811729563143950958709031230206606381509868512618172844657807114390339553440364**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, with two NEW constructions (not in PR1673 or PR1699): a radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md) and structured boundary solves (outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md): the Gaussian blocks of a phase cell are D_r T D_c with T Toeplitz, so segment, coupling and pivot blocks of the boundary algebra have constant displacement rank and are applied by generator representations and FFT in O(r W log W) per right-hand-side column, tau_eff = 2 + 1e-64. The 55 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls (including the old union row and tau_eff at or below 2, which fail) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; three executable checks (union schedule, independent schedule simulation, exact displacement-rank/structured-solve check) are run; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; both new constructions need independent review; the precision argument of the structured solves is an error argument, not a verified theorem.

Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (55 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row and tau_eff at or below 2, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the exact structured-boundary displacement-rank check and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016783441717365385237811729563143950958709031230206606381509868512618172844657807114390339553440364 (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; structured boundary solves outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md, tau_eff=2+1e-64).
